claims: As of April 2026, XO, Kitty has not been officially renewed for a fourth season by Netflix.
XO, Kitty season 3 was released on April 2, 2026.
XO, Kitty season 3 was filmed in summer 2025.
XO, Kitty season 3 concluded with Kitty and Min Ho together, heading to Portland.
Anna Cathcart plays Kitty in XO, Kitty.
Sang Heon Lee plays Min Ho in XO, Kitty.
XO, Kitty season 3 is now streaming on Netflix.
